record.bible_text: The word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068> came also unto me, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

They shall die<WH04191><WTH8799> of grievous<WH08463> deaths<WH04463>; they shall not be lamented<WH05594><WTH8735>; neither shall they be buried<WH06912><WTH8735>; <FI>but<Fi> they shall be as dung<WH01828> upon the face<WH06440> of the earth<WH0127>: and they shall be consumed<WH03615><WTH8799> by the sword<WH02719>, and by famine<WH07458>; and their carcases<WH05038> shall be meat<WH03978> for the fowls<WH05775> of heaven<WH08064>, and for the beasts<WH0929> of the earth<WH0776>.

For thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>, Enter<WH0935><WTH8799> not into the house<WH01004> of mourning<WH04798>, neither go<WH03212><WTH8799> to lament<WH05594><WTH8800> nor bemoan<WH05110><WTH8799> them: for I have taken away<WH0622><WTH8804> my peace<WH07965> from this people<WH05971>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>, <FI>even<Fi> lovingkindness<WH02617> and mercies<WH07356>. <RF>mourning: or, mourning feast<Rf>

Both the great<WH01419> and the small<WH06996> shall die<WH04191><WTH8804> in this land<WH0776>: they shall not be buried<WH06912><WTH8735>, neither shall <FI>men<Fi> lament<WH05594><WTH8799> for them, nor cut<WH01413><WTH8704> themselves, nor make themselves bald<WH07139><WTH8735> for them:

Thou shalt not also go<WH0935><WTH8799> into the house<WH01004> of feasting<WH04960>, to sit<WH03427><WTH8800> with them to eat<WH0398><WTH8800> and to drink<WH08354><WTH8800>.

For thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635>, the God<WH0430> of Israel<WH03478>; Behold, I will cause to cease<WH07673><WTH8688> out of this place<WH04725> in your eyes<WH05869>, and in your days<WH03117>, the voice<WH06963> of mirth<WH08342>, and the voice<WH06963> of gladness<WH08057>, the voice<WH06963> of the bridegroom<WH02860>, and the voice<WH06963> of the bride<WH03618>.<CM>

And it shall come to pass, when thou shalt shew<WH05046><WTH8686> this people<WH05971> all these words<WH01697>, and they shall say<WH0559><WTH8804> unto thee, Wherefore hath the LORD<WH03068> pronounced<WH01696><WTH8765> all this great<WH01419> evil<WH07451> against us? or what <FI>is<Fi> our iniquity<WH05771>? or what <FI>is<Fi> our sin<WH02403> that we have committed<WH02398><WTH8804> against the LORD<WH03068> our God<WH0430>?

Then shalt thou say<WH0559><WTH8804> unto them, Because your fathers<WH01> have forsaken<WH05800><WTH8804> me, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>, and have walked<WH03212><WTH8799> after<WH0310> other<WH0312> gods<WH0430>, and have served<WH05647><WTH8799> them, and have worshipped<WH07812><WTH8691> them, and have forsaken<WH05800><WTH8804> me, and have not kept<WH08104><WTH8804> my law<WH08451>;

And ye have done<WH06213><WTH8800> worse<WH07489><WTH8689> than your fathers<WH01>; for, behold<WH02009>, ye walk<WH01980><WTH8802> every one<WH0376> after<WH0310> the imagination<WH08307> of his evil<WH07451> heart<WH03820>, that they may not hearken<WH08085><WTH8800> unto me: <RF>imagination: or, stubbornness<Rf>

Therefore will I cast<WH02904><WTH8689> you out of this land<WH0776> into a land<WH0776> that ye know<WH03045><WTH8804> not, <FI>neither<Fi> ye nor your fathers<WH01>; and there shall ye serve<WH05647><WTH8804> other<WH0312> gods<WH0430> day<WH03119> and night<WH03915>; where I will not shew<WH05414><WTH8799> you favour<WH02594>.<CM>

Therefore, behold, the days<WH03117> come<WH0935><WTH8802>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>, that it shall no more be said<WH0559><WTH8735>, The LORD<WH03068> liveth<WH02416>, that brought up<WH05927><WTH8689> the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478> out of the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714>;

But, The LORD<WH03068> liveth<WH02416>, that brought up<WH05927><WTH8689> the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478> from the land<WH0776> of the north<WH06828>, and from all the lands<WH0776> whither he had driven<WH05080><WTH8689> them: and I will bring them again<WH07725><WTH8689> into their land<WH0127> that I gave<WH05414><WTH8804> unto their fathers<WH01>.

Behold, I will send<WH07971><WTH8802> for many<WH07227> fishers<WH01771><WTH8675><WH01728>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>, and they shall fish<WH01770><WTH8804> them; and after<WH0310> will I send<WH07971><WTH8799> for many<WH07227> hunters<WH06719>, and they shall hunt<WH06679><WTH8804> them from every mountain<WH02022>, and from every hill<WH01389>, and out of the holes<WH05357> of the rocks<WH05553>.

For mine eyes<WH05869> <FI>are<Fi> upon all their ways<WH01870>: they are not hid<WH05641><WTH8738> from my face<WH06440>, neither is their iniquity<WH05771> hid<WH06845><WTH8738> from<WH05048> mine eyes<WH05869>.

And first<WH07223> I will recompense<WH07999><WTH8765> their iniquity<WH05771> and their sin<WH02403> double<WH04932>; because they have defiled<WH02490><WTH8763> my land<WH0776>, they have filled<WH04390><WTH8804> mine inheritance<WH05159> with the carcases<WH05038> of their detestable<WH08251> and abominable things<WH08441>.

Shall a man<WH0120> make<WH06213><WTH8799> gods<WH0430> unto himself, and they <FI>are<Fi> no gods<WH0430>?

Therefore, behold, I will this once<WH06471> cause them to know<WH03045><WTH8688>, I will cause them to know<WH03045><WTH8686> mine hand<WH03027> and my might<WH01369>; and they shall know<WH03045><WTH8804> that my name<WH08034> <FI>is<Fi> The LORD<WH03068>. <RF>The LORD: or, JEHOVAH<Rf><CM>
